name: CreateProcessDialog
intent: Bind a new state machine to an ontology object type: name, icon, backing object type and the property that holds its state value.
when: A Studio surface offers to create a process
Any authoring flow that binds a workflow to an object type
whenNot: Editing an existing process's graph -> open the process detail canvas
Creating a pipeline -> that is a different draft shape

chooseOver.because: This carries the domain rules a fresh copy would not: the status-property heuristic, the live backing-row count, and the warning that another process already claims that object type — tokens are keyed by object type, so two processes on ot_permit share the same rows.

onCreate.note: Receives a DRAFT, not a record — the caller builds it with createProcess() and drills in.

processes.note: Read only to answer whether the chosen object type is already claimed.

dataContract.rowIdentity: Object type ids come from the shared ontology; process ids are minted by the caller.

states.default: Empty form, footer guidance, nothing painted invalid.
states.refused: A Create press while incomplete names exactly what is missing.
states.claimed: An amber caveat when another process already backs the chosen object type.
states.bound: Once an object type is picked, the status property is pre-filled by heuristic and the backing row count is stated.

minimalExample:
import {CreateProcessDialog} from "@wakecap/core-ui/pages/create-process-dialog";

<CreateProcessDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} processes={processes} onCreate={(draft) => open(createProcess(draft))} />
evaluationCriteria: The status property is pre-filled once an object type is chosen.
A already-claimed object type raises the shared-tokens caveat.
